1: Us Allah ki bhalai badi aur bohat zyada hai jo yakta badshahat ka maalik hai. Wahi har cheez par qaadir hai, koi cheez us ki quwwat se baahar nahin.
2: Wahi jis ne maut aur zindagi paida ki taake tumhein aazmaye, aey logo, ke tum mein se kaun aamaal mein behtar hai. Wahi zabardast hai jis par koi ghalib nahin aa sakta; apne bandon mein se jo us ki taraf tauba kare us ke gunah bakshne wala.
3: Wahi jis ne saat aasman paida kiye, har ek apne se pehle wale ke oopar tah-ba-tah, bagair us ko chhue. Aey dekhne wale! Tum Allah ki takhleeq mein koi be-tarteebi ya kami na dekhoge. Pas phir dekho, kya tumhein koi daraar ya shigaaf nazar aata hai? Tum unhein kabhi na dekhoge; tum sirf ek mukammal, kamal ki takhleeq dekhoge.
4: Phir baar baar dekho; tumhari nazar zaleel ho kar lautegi, aasman ki takhleeq mein koi aib ya khami na paa kar; thak kar, dekhne se aajiz.
5: Aur beshak Hum ne zameen se qareeb tareen aasman ko chamakte sitaron se sajaya, unhein girne wale banaya aur un ke zariye un shaytanon ko bhagaya jo chhup kar sunne ki koshish karte hain. Hum ne un ke liye aakhirat mein ek bhadakti aag bhi tayyar ki hai.
6: Aur un logon ke liye, jo apne Rubb ke saath kufr karte hain, Qayamat ke din ek jalti aag ka azaab hai. Bohat buri hai woh jagah jis ki taraf woh lautenge.
7: Jab woh Jahannam ki aag mein phenke jaayenge to woh ek nihayat buri awaaz sunenge: woh ek khaulti handi ki tarah ubal rahi hogi.
8: Woh qareeb hai ke apne andar se phat jaaye aur reza reza ho jaaye, un logon par apne shadeed ghusse ki wajah se jo us mein phenke jaate hain. Jab bhi kafiron mein se ek giroh us mein phenka jayega, us par muqarrar farishte un se malamat karte hue poochhenge: 'Kya tumhare paas duniya mein koi Rasool na aaya tha, jo tumhein Allah ke azaab se darata?'
9: Kafir kahenge: 'Beshak! Ek Rasool hamare paas aaya tha jo hamein Allah ke azaab se darata tha lekin hum ne use jhutlaya, aur hum ne us se kaha: Allah ne koi wahi nazil nahin ki. Aey Rasoolo! Tum khuli gumrahi ke siwa kuchh nahin jo haqq se door hai.'
10: Kafir kahenge: 'Agar hum ne tawajjo se suna hota, ya us shaks ki tarah saaf socha hota jo haqq ko batil se alag kar sakta hai, to hum Jahannam walon mein se na hote. Balke hum Rasoolon par iman laate aur un ke laaye hue paigham par yaqeen karte, aur Jannat walon mein se hote.'
11: Pas woh apne khilaf iqrar karenge ke unhon ne kufr aur jhutlana kiya, aur is tarah woh Jahannam ke haqqdaar hue. Pas Jahannam walon par afsos!
12: Allah ne kafiron ki sifaat aur un ke badle ka zikr karne ke baad iman walon ki sifaat aur un ke badle ka zikr kiya, farmate hue: 'Beshak jo log tanhai mein Allah se darte hain, un ke gunah bakhsh diye jaayenge aur unhein bada ajar milega, yani Jannat.'
13: Aey logo! Chhup kar baat karo ya khule-aam; Allah use har soorat sunta hai. Beshak woh, woh paak hai, us har cheez se khabardaar hai jo us ke bandon ke dilon mein hai; is baare mein us se kuchh poshida nahin.
14: Kya woh, jis ne tamam makhlooq paida ki, bhed ko nahin jaanta, aur us ko jo bhed se bhi zyada poshida hai? Wahi apne bandon par meharban hai; un ke maamlon se khabardaar. Is baare mein us se kuchh poshida nahin.
15: Wahi hai jis ne zameen ko tumhare rehne ke liye narm aur aasan banaya, pas us ke kinaron mein chalo phiro aur us rizq mein se khao jo us ne tumhare liye us mein tayyar kiya. Usi ki taraf tum hisaab aur badle ke liye dobara uthaye jaoge.
16: Kya tum us hasti se, jo aasmanon mein hai, mehfooz samajhte ho ke woh zameen ko tumhare neeche se phaad de, jaise us ne Qaroon ke neeche se phaad diya, is ke bawajood ke woh rehne ke liye narm aur aasan thi? Woh tumhare saath achanak hil sakti hai, mazboot aur thos hone ke baad.
17: Ya kya tum us hasti se, jo aasmanon mein hai, mehfooz samajhte ho ke woh tum par patthar barsa de jaise us ne Lut (alaihis salaam) ki qaum par barsaye? Phir tumhein maaloom ho jayega, jab tum khud Mera azaab dekhoge, ke mere darawe kya the. Lekin tum azaab dekh lene ke baad un se kabhi faida na utha sakoge.
18: Beshak un qaumon ne, jo in mushrikon se pehle aayin, jhutlaya, aur chunanche Allah ka azaab un par utra is ke baad ke woh apne kufr aur jhutlane par ar gaye, pas un se mera bari hona kaisa tha? Beshak woh ek sakht bari hona tha.
19: Kya yeh jhutlane wale apne oopar un parindon ko nahin dekhte jo qataaron mein, ek doosre ke saath, urte hain? Unhein zameen par girne se Allah ke siwa kis cheez ne roka hai? Beshak wahi har cheez ko dekhne wala hai, us se kuchh poshida nahin.
20: Aey kafiro! Koi lashkar nahin jo tumhein Allah ke azaab se bacha sake agar woh tumhein saza dene ka faisla kar le. Kafir dhoke ke siwa kuchh mein nahin; Shaytan ne unhein dhoka diya aur woh us ke dhoke mein par gaye.
21: Aur koi nahin jo tumhein rizq de sake agar Allah apna rizq tum tak pahunchne se roke rakhe. Balke asal baat yeh hai ke kafir sarkashi, takabbur aur haqq ke inkar mein bohat aage barh gaye hain.
22: To kya woh shaks, jo apne mu ke bal girta hua chalta hai, yani mushrik, zyada hidayat par hai, ya woh momin jo seedhe raaste par seedha chalta hai?
23: Aey Rasool! In jhutlane wale mushrikon se keh dein: 'Allah hi woh hai jis ne tumhein paida kiya aur tumhare liye kaan banaye jin se tum sunte ho, aankhein jin se tum dekhte ho, aur dil jin se tum sochte ho. Tum un niyamaton par us ka bohat kam shukr karte ho jo us ne tum par ki hain.'
24: Aey Rasool! In jhutlane wale mushrikon se keh dein: 'Allah hi woh hai jis ne tumhein zameen par phaila diya aur tumhein us par bikher diya, tumhare but nahin jo kuchh paida nahin kar sakte. Usi ki taraf tum Qayamat ke din hisaab aur badle ke liye jama kiye jaoge, tumhare buton ki taraf nahin. Pas us se daro aur sirf us ki ibadat karo.'
25: Aur dobara uthne ke munkir, use door ki baat samajhte hue, kehte hain: 'Aey Muhammad ﷺ! Yeh waada, jis ka tum aur tumhare sahaba hum se waada karte ho, kab poora hoga, agar tum apne is daawe mein sachche ho ke woh hoga?'
26: Keh dein, aey Rasool: 'Qayamat ka ilm Allah ke paas hai; sirf wahi jaanta hai ke woh kab hogi. Main to sirf apne tumhein darane mein khula darane wala hoon.'
27: Pas jab woh waada un par aa jayega aur woh Qayamat ke din azaab ko apne qareeb dekhenge, to un logon ke chehre, jin ne Allah ke saath kufr kiya, badal jaayenge aur siyah ho jaayenge. Aur un se kaha jayega: 'Yeh wahi hai jis ki tum jaldi machate aur maangte the!'
28: Aey Rasool! In jhutlane wale mushrikon se, unhein malamat karte hue, keh dein: 'Mujhe batao, agar Allah mujhe aur un ko, jo mere saath hain, yani mominon ko, maut de de, to kafiron ko dard-naak azaab se kaun bachayega?' Koi unhein us se kabhi na bachayega.
29: Aey Rasool! In mushrikon se keh dein: 'Wahi Rehman hai jo tumhein sirf apni ibadat ki taraf bulata hai. Hum us par iman laaye, aur apne maamlon mein sirf us hi par bharosa karte hain. Tum jald, yaqeenan, jaan loge ke kaun khuli gumrahi mein tha aur kaun seedhe raaste par.'
30: Aey Rasool! In mushrikon se keh dein: 'Mujhe batao, agar woh paani, jis se tum peete ho, zameen mein chala jaaye aur tum us tak na pahunch sako, to kaun tumhare liye bohat sa behta paani le aayega?' Allah ke siwa koi na laa sakta.
